issue_context.title: Implement tests for encoding collections in Proto
issue_context.body:
### What would you like to be added?

Re-implement similar tests as in https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/130220 just for proto package. 
/cc @chenk008 @yulongfang @nkeert @z1cheng

### Why is this needed?

Required to implement Proto response streaming described in https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/tree/master/keps/sig-api-machinery/5116-streaming-response-encoding#e2e-tests

Tracked in https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/issues/5116

review_comments:
Interestingly, we just bumped into proto serialization weirdness around typemeta - https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/130568#issuecomment-2698779187

It looks like ~nothing inside top-level type meta fields is going to get proto serialized into the object itself, but maybe gets serialized into the envelope wrapper, which is super weird

For nested objects like these, I think all the typemeta fields get dropped entirely :-/

I don't think there's any change to make here for that, more just an observation that proto serialization is super weird.

Yes, I was aware of this behavior after reading the code 

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/30ea0d13cdeeb501625e90819886881930e67017/staging/src/k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/runtime/serializer/protobuf/protobuf.go#L191-L211

It's wired but makes sense. Proto types deserialization just needs to determine type on top level, so it's redundant to encode TypeMeta on each level. Unknown encodes top level type metadata, while type meta in proto encoder is omitted.
